title: Deliver
summary: Check a delivery plan against what is actually happening: ask the owners, watch the dependencies, project a new date when something moves, explore ways to recover, and write the update for whoever needs it.

library.summary: Check a plan with its owners, project the date when something moves, find ways to recover, and write the update.
library.prompt: Update the delivery status for {{plan: a plan document, a dataset in data/, or a list of milestones}} using the delivery-status skill. The update is for {{audience: for example "the steering group"}}.

inputs.name: plan
inputs.hint: The plan: a document, a dataset of milestones, or a list in the chat.

steps: Check each milestone with its owner

when: The person wants a status update, or to know whether a date still holds and what is at risk
not_when: A one-line answer about a single milestone already known
routing.needs: The plan: a document, a dataset of milestones, or a list in the chat
routing.offer: I can check the plan against what is actually happening, ask the owners, project a new date if something moved, and write the update.

start: Update the delivery status for the held payments launch.
offer: Is the March date still real? I need to tell my director.
open: How do other teams usually report slips?

invariants: Never invent a date or capacity
Never choose a recovery option for the person
Always include accepting the new date as an option
